简介: Female Equestrian with a passion for Dressage. Full time groom in Dorset and part time Sports Massage therapist for Humans (OSSM level 5)and Horses (Equissage Europe). The correlation between rider asymmetry and horses fascinates me along with the biomechanics and rehabilitation side of the horse world. Had my own horse since 11years old but sadly sold my dressage horse around 7years ago and have since trained and competed on my employers horses. Up until 2020 the horses we had on the yard were not for dressage but since then we have purchased the lovely Hanoverian Finnick SR and our training and competing has commenced and so far been pretty successful. I suppose the dream is to go the nationals, however every outing we have i see as learning and training. The scores and frills are all a bonus. I enjoy doing groundwork with all the horses and vary their work with regular hacking, polework, jumping, lunging, inhand poles and schooling. please enjoy following our adventures.

C Double Stables is a family owned and operated equestrian facility located in Dawson Creek, BC, CA.
